name: Amaretto Sour
method: Add all ingredients to a shaker with ice.
Shake hard until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over fresh ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: French 75
method: Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice.
Strain into a chilled flute.
Top slowly with Champagne.
Garnish and serve.

name: Passion Fruit Martini
garnish: Half a passion fruit on the rim
method: Shake all ingredients (except Prosecco) hard with ice.
Double strain into a chilled martini glass.
Serve with a side shot of Prosecco.
Garnish and serve.

name: Whiskey Sour
method: Dry shake all ingredients without ice.
Add ice and shake again until chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Bloody Mary
ingredients: Pinch of celery salt and black pepper
method: Build all ingredients in a highball glass over ice.
Stir gently to combine.
Garnish and serve.

name: Aperol Spritz
method: Fill a balloon glass with ice.
Add Aperol, then Prosecco.
Top with a splash of soda water.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Negroni
method: Add all ingredients to a mixing glass with ice.
Stir until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Espresso Martini
method: Shake all ingredients hard with plenty of ice.
Double strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Hennessy Ginger
method: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add Hennessy and a squeeze of lime.
Top with ginger ale and stir gently.
Garnish and serve.

name: Mojito
method: Muddle mint gently with lime juice and syrup.
Add rum and fill glass with crushed ice.
Top with soda water and stir.
Garnish and serve.

name: Daiquiri
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Double strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Limoncello Spritz
method: Fill a balloon glass with ice.
Add limoncello, then Prosecco.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish and serve.

name: Margarita
method: Salt the rim of a coupe or rocks glass.
Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into the prepared glass over ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Old Fashioned
method: Muddle the sugar cube with bitters and a splash of water.
Add bourbon and a large ice cube.
Stir until chilled.
Garnish and serve.

name: Champagne Cocktail
method: Soak the sugar cube in bitters and drop into a flute.
Add a dash of brandy if using.
Top slowly with Champagne.
Garnish and serve.

name: Bellini
method: Add peach puree to a chilled flute.
Top slowly with Prosecco.
Stir gently and serve.

name: Kir Royale
method: Add crème de cassis to a chilled flute.
Top slowly with Champagne.
Serve immediately.

name: Hugo Spritz
method: Fill a balloon glass with ice and mint.
Add elderflower, then Prosecco.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish and serve.

name: Vodka Martini
method: Stir (or shake) with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Gin Martini
method: Stir with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Baileys Hot Chocolate
ingredients: Hot chocolate, filled to the top
method: Add Baileys to a warmed mug.
Top with hot chocolate.
Finish with whipped cream and garnish.

name: Baileys Coffee
ingredients: Hot filter coffee, filled to the top
method: Add Baileys to a warmed glass.
Top with hot coffee.
Float cream gently on top and serve.

name: Irish Coffee
ingredients: Hot filter coffee, filled to the top
method: Dissolve sugar in the whiskey in a warmed glass.
Top with hot coffee and stir.
Float cream gently on top and serve.

name: Virgin Mojito
method: Muddle mint gently with lime juice and syrup.
Fill glass with crushed ice.
Top with soda water and stir.
Garnish and serve.

name: Shirley Temple
method: Fill a highball glass with ice.
Add grenadine, then top with ginger ale.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Elderflower Spritz (Non Alc)
method: Fill a balloon glass with ice.
Add elderflower cordial and lime juice.
Top with soda water and stir gently.
Garnish and serve.

name: Light & Zesty Mocktail
method: Build citrus juices over ice in a highball glass.
Top with soda water and stir.
Garnish with mint and a citrus wheel.

name: Crimson Cooler Mocktail
method: Build cranberry juice and grenadine over ice.
Top with ginger ale and a squeeze of lime.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Non Alc Italian Orange Spritz
ingredients: Italian orange soda (e.g. San Bitter style)
method: Fill a balloon glass with ice.
Add orange soda and top with soda water.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Mai Tai
method: Shake all ingredients hard with crushed ice.
Pour unstrained into a rocks glass.
Garnish and serve with a straw.

name: Piña Colada
method: Blend all ingredients with ice until smooth.
Pour into a balloon glass.
Garnish and serve with a straw.

name: Cosmopolitan
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Double strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Manhattan
method: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Sidecar
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a sugar-rimmed coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Tom Collins
method: Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice.
Strain into a highball over fresh ice.
Top with soda water, garnish and serve.

name: Gin Fizz
method: Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup hard with ice.
Strain into a highball over ice.
Top with soda water, garnish and serve.

name: Singapore Sling
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a highball over ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Dark 'n' Stormy
method: Fill a highball with ice.
Add lime juice, then float the dark rum on top of the ginger beer.
Garnish and serve.

name: Moscow Mule
method: Fill a copper mug with ice.
Add vodka and lime juice.
Top with ginger beer, garnish and serve.

name: Paloma
method: Salt the rim of a highball glass.
Fill with ice and add tequila and lime juice.
Top with grapefruit soda, garnish and serve.

name: Long Island Iced Tea
method: Shake all spirits and lemon juice with ice.
Strain into a highball over ice.
Top with cola, garnish and serve.

name: White Russian
ingredients: Top with fresh cream or milk
method: Build vodka and coffee liqueur over ice in a rocks glass.
Float cream on top.
Stir gently and serve.

name: Black Russian
method: Build both ingredients over ice in a rocks glass.
Stir gently and serve.

name: Mudslide
method: Shake or blend all ingredients with ice.
Pour into a rocks glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Zombie
method: Shake all ingredients hard with crushed ice.
Pour unstrained into a tall glass.
Garnish and serve with a straw.

name: Hurricane
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Pour into a hurricane or balloon glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Sex on the Beach
method: Build all ingredients over ice in a highball glass.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Blue Lagoon
method: Build vodka and blue curaçao over ice in a highball.
Top with lemonade, garnish and serve.

name: Sea Breeze
method: Build all ingredients over ice in a highball glass.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Bay Breeze
method: Build all ingredients over ice in a highball glass.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Screwdriver
method: Build vodka over ice in a highball glass.
Top with orange juice.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Tequila Sunrise
method: Build tequila and orange juice over ice in a highball.
Slowly pour grenadine so it sinks and settles.
Garnish and serve.

name: Gimlet
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Rusty Nail
method: Build both ingredients over ice in a rocks glass.
Stir gently, garnish and serve.

name: Godfather
method: Build both ingredients over ice in a rocks glass.
Stir gently and serve.

name: Godmother
method: Build both ingredients over ice in a rocks glass.
Stir gently and serve.

name: Grasshopper
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Brandy Alexander
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Sazerac
method: Rinse a chilled rocks glass with absinthe and discard the excess.
Muddle sugar cube with bitters, add whiskey and ice.
Stir until chilled and strain into the prepared glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Mint Julep
method: Muddle mint gently with sugar syrup.
Add bourbon and pack the glass with crushed ice.
Stir until frosted, garnish and serve.

name: Boulevardier
method: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Vieux Carré
method: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Corpse Reviver No. 2
method: Rinse a chilled coupe with absinthe.
Shake remaining ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into the prepared glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Clover Club
method: Dry shake all ingredients without ice.
Add ice and shake again until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Bramble
method: Shake gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass filled with crushed ice.
Drizzle blackberry liqueur over the top.
Garnish and serve.

name: Aviation
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Garnish and serve.

name: Last Word
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Serve.

name: Paper Plane
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Serve.

name: Penicillin
method: Shake blended Scotch, lemon juice and honey-ginger syrup with ice.
Strain into a rocks glass over ice.
Float the Islay Scotch on top.
Garnish and serve.

name: Amaretto Stone Sour
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a highball over ice.
Garnish and serve.

name: Cuba Libre
method: Build rum and lime juice over ice in a highball.
Top with cola, garnish and serve.

name: Dirty Martini
method: Stir all ingredients with ice until well chilled.
Strain into a chilled martini glass.
Garnish and serve.

name: Caipirinha
method: Muddle lime wedges with sugar syrup in a rocks glass.
Fill with crushed ice and add cachaça.
Stir well, garnish and serve.

name: Mimosa
method: Add orange juice to a chilled flute.
Top slowly with Champagne.
Stir gently and serve.

name: French Connection
method: Build both ingredients over ice in a rocks glass.
Stir gently and serve.

name: B-52
method: Pour coffee liqueur into a glass first.
Layer Irish cream slowly over the back of a spoon.
Layer orange liqueur on top the same way.
Serve immediately.

name: Irish Mule
method: Fill a copper mug with ice.
Add whiskey and lime juice.
Top with ginger beer, garnish and serve.

name: Jack Rose
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Strain into a chilled coupe.
Serve.

name: French Martini
method: Shake all ingredients hard with ice.
Double strain into a chilled martini glass.
Serve.
